title: 第20章与宁风致做交易，让我拜师还不够格-《斗罗V：开局绑定朱竹清，创建神级家族》
content:
第(1/3)页

    宁风致见宁荣荣不配合，顺势将管教的任务交到了叶寒的手上。

    他这样做，一是看中了叶寒的人品，敢不顾及宁荣荣的身份，出手教育，有助于宁荣荣快速改掉大小姐脾气等恶习。

    二是他觉得叶寒是一个资质不凡的天才，想让两人在这个过程中培养出感情。

    若是宁荣荣能跟叶寒走在一起，对于宁荣荣本人和七宝琉璃宗来讲，都是一件大喜事。

    “爸爸，你不能这样。”

    “我是你亲闺女，你怎能把我交给别人管教。”

    宁荣荣听到宁风致的决定，瞬间慌了。

    这要是让叶寒拿到了‘免死金牌’，以后岂不是更不会顾忌她的身份，不给她面前，毫无顾忌地教训她。

    其实，宁荣荣完全想多了。

    就算是没有宁风致刚才那番话，叶寒也不会把她的身份放在眼里。

    “风致，这样确实不好。”

    剑斗罗对宁风致的性格也很了解。

    知道他这么做无疑是想给叶寒和宁荣荣制造相处的机会。

    但两人都是同学，机会多的是，没必要这样。

    万一叶寒在管教宁荣荣的方法上有所欠缺，吃亏受苦的只会是他的宝贝孙女。

    “剑叔，这件事就这么决定。”

    “你不要管！”

    “我看也只有这小子才能制住荣荣的臭脾气。”

    宁风致知道剑斗罗的同情心又开始泛滥了，立即遏制他的想法。

    如果他现在都不能狠下心来，宁荣荣就真的废了。

    “好吧！”

    剑斗罗见宁风致如此认真，也只能答应了。

    “慢着，你们问过我意见了吗？”

    “我有什么义务帮你们管教她？”

    叶寒当然也能明白宁风致的一部分用意。

    无非是想借他的手，来教育宁荣荣，让她逐渐走向正道，改善性格。

    虽然他打心底里没有意见，可以将宁荣荣掌控在手中，慢慢培养忠诚度，为家族做贡献。

    但是，他可不会免费帮着这个忙。

    必须谈条件。

    既然七宝琉璃宗是斗罗大陆最强大的三大宗门之一，肯定有丰厚的财力和资源。

    他倒不如趁此机会，让七宝琉璃宗替他收集一下药材，方便他研究炼丹之术。

    宁荣荣见叶寒不同意，暗自松了口气。

    只要他不同意，就算是爸爸再怎么想让叶寒管教她，也不可能的。

    “小兄弟，你说得对，确实没有义务帮我。”

    “这样吧，你提个条件，只要是我能做到，我都答应。”

    “但前提是，你必须要把荣荣帮我管教好。”

    宁风致就知道他不会同意，但这都不重要。

    他相信，只要条件给足了，任何事情都不是问题。

    “既然宁宗主这么有诚意，我若是不答应，也不好。”

    “这样吧，你答应我两个条件，宁荣荣以后便交给我来管教。”

    叶寒见宁风致上当了，打算接下这个轻而易举的任务。

    宁风致见他心动了，痛快道：“你尽管说。”

    他就知道，叶寒忍不住诱惑。

    “第一个条件，你们要为我收集各种药材，年限越高越好。”

    “若是我用这些药材炼制出能提升修为的丹药，可以分你们一成。”

    “第二个条件，我想跟剑前辈讨教一下剑招！”

    叶寒将他的要求讲了出来。

    尤其是第一个要求，必须要将对七宝琉璃宗有利的地方说出来。

    只有让宁风致得到想要的东西，才会让七宝琉璃宗为他提供源源不断的药材。

    一成丹药，已经算是高额回报了。

    “第二个要求没问题，我想剑叔愿意指点你几招。”

    “只是第一个要求，有点不好说。”

    “你确定能拿药材炼制出能快速提升修为的丹药？”
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

Seeing that Ning Rongrong was not cooperating, Ning Fengzhi handed over the discipline task to Ye Han.

He did this because he took a fancy to Ye Han's character and dared to teach Ning Rongrong regardless of Ning Rongrong's identity, which would help Ning Rongrong quickly get rid of bad habits such as the young lady's temper.

Second, he felt that Ye Han was a genius with extraordinary qualifications, and he wanted the two of them to develop a relationship in the process.

If Ning Rongrong and Ye Han can get together, it will be a great joy for Ning Rongrong and the Qibao Glazed Sect.

"Dad, you can't do this."

"I am your daughter, how can you leave me to others to discipline me."

When Ning Rongrong heard Ning Fengzhi’s decision, she panicked instantly.

“ If Ye Han gets the ‘gold medal for immunity from death’, wouldn’t he be less concerned about her identity in the future and teach her a lesson without any scruples in front of her?

In fact, Ning Rongrong was completely overthinking it.

Even without what Ning Fengzhi said just now, Ye Han would not take her identity seriously.

"Fengzhi, this is really not good."

Sword Douluo also knew Ning Fengzhi’s character very well.

Knowing that he did this was undoubtedly to create a chance for Ye Han and Ning Rongrong to get along.

But since both of them are classmates, there are many opportunities, so there is no need for this.

“If Ye Han fails in the way he disciplines Ning Rongrong, it will only be his precious granddaughter who suffers.

"Uncle Jian, this matter has been decided."

"Don't worry!"

"I think this guy is the only one who can control Rongrong's bad temper."

Ning Fengzhi knew that Sword Douluo's sympathy was beginning to overflow again, so he immediately curbed his thoughts.

If he can't be cruel now, Ning Rongrong will really be ruined.

"Okay!"

Seeing that Ning Fengzhi was so serious, Sword Douluo could only agree.

“Wait a minute, have you asked me for my opinion?”

"What obligation do I have to help you discipline her?"

Of course, Ye Han could understand part of Ning Fengzhi's intentions.

It is nothing more than wanting to use his hand to educate Ning Rongrong, so that she can gradually move towards the right path and improve her character.

Although he had no objections from the bottom of his heart, he could control Ning Rongrong, slowly cultivate loyalty, and contribute to the family.

But, he won’t do this for free.

Conditions must be negotiated.

Since the Qibao Glazed Sect is one of the three most powerful sects in Douluo Continent, it must have abundant financial resources and resources.

He might as well take this opportunity and ask the Qibao Glazed Sect to collect medicinal materials for him so that he can study the art of alchemy.

Ning Rongrong secretly breathed a sigh of relief when he saw that Ye Han disagreed.

As long as he disagrees, no matter how hard her father wants Ye Han to discipline her, it will be impossible.

"Little brother, you are right, you really have no obligation to help me."

“Let’s do this, you make a condition, as long as I can do it, I will agree to it.”

"But the premise is that you must help me discipline Rongrong."

Ning Fengzhi knew he wouldn't agree, but that didn't matter.

He believes that as long as the conditions are met, nothing will be a problem.

"Since Sect Leader Ning is so sincere, it would be bad if I didn't agree."

"Let's do this. You promise me two conditions, and Ning Rongrong will be handed over to me to discipline her from now on."

Seeing that Ning Fengzhi had been fooled, Ye Han planned to take on this easy task.

Ning Fengzhi saw that his heart was moved, and said happily: "You can just say it."

He knew that Ye Han couldn't resist the temptation.

"The first condition is that you must collect various medicinal materials for me. The older you are, the better."

"If I use these medicinal materials to refine a pill that can improve my cultivation, I can share 10% of it with you."

"Second condition, I want to ask Senior Jian for advice on sword moves!"

Ye Han stated his request.

Especially the first request, you must state what is beneficial to the Qibao Glazed Sect.

Only if Ning Fengzhi gets what he wants will the Qibao Glazed Sect provide him with a steady stream of medicinal materials.

10% of the elixir is already considered a high return.

"The second request is no problem. I think Uncle Jian is willing to give you some tips."

“It’s just the first request, it’s a bit hard to say.”

"Are you sure you can use medicinal materials to refine a pill that can quickly improve your cultivation?"
Page (1/3)
title_en: Chapter 20: Making a deal with Ning Fengzhi, I am not qualified to become a disciple - "Douluo V: Binding Zhu Zhuqing at the beginning, creating a god-level family"
